description: 6 chains x 5 sequential coding edits; test each checkpoint cumulatively. Not hidden, not calibrated to real-world task difficulty.

tasks.title: Clean collection
tasks.request: Implement normalize_catalog(rows): accept a list of valid {id,name} records. Return records with id as string and normalized name, preserving all entries in deterministic alphabetical name order.
acceptance: Valid items are returned with id and name

tasks.title: Whitespace and case
tasks.request: Extend catalog normalization: collapse repeated whitespace and casefold names. Preserve behavior required by stage 1 and do not mutate input rows.

tasks.title: Deduplication
tasks.request: Extend catalog normalization: duplicate ids use the LAST valid record. IDs are normalized to strings before equality, and earlier stages must remain correct.

tasks.title: Malformed entries
tasks.request: Extend catalog normalization: ignore malformed or missing-id records, empty ids or empty names without exceptions. Preserve earlier behavior.

tasks.title: Stable order
tasks.request: Finalize catalog: deterministic sort by normalized name and id; identical content in any input order should produce identical output for distinct ids. Preserve all earlier requirements.

tasks.title: Role ACL
tasks.request: Implement decide(request) returning a boolean. Viewer may read, editor may read/write, admin may read/write/delete. Unknown actions or roles deny by default.

tasks.title: Tenant boundary
tasks.request: Add tenant isolation: where a resource tenant is supplied, actor_tenant must match. Keep role matrix unchanged. Deny unknown tenant identity.

tasks.title: Approval required
tasks.request: Add explicit approval gate: delete requires approved is exactly True; truthy strings do not qualify. Preserve previous authorization checks.

tasks.title: Expiring access
tasks.request: When expires_at is provided, require integer now and expires_at and strict now < expires_at. Preserve previous rules.

tasks.title: Revocations
tasks.request: If revoked is exactly True, authorization is denied even for admin with a valid permit. Preserve previous behavior and fail closed.

tasks.title: Basic time grid
tasks.request: Implement slots(request) producing integer start times. request includes start,end,duration,step in minutes, and return every valid position within [start,end).
acceptance: End boundary excluded for non-fitting slots

tasks.title: Blocked intervals
tasks.request: Add blocked as half-open [start,end] minute pairs; no returned slot may intersect an occupied interval. Preserve basic behavior.

tasks.title: Boundary cases
tasks.request: Handle meetings touching block endpoints as nonoverlapping: slot ending exactly when a block begins or starting at block end is valid.

tasks.title: Multiple blockers
tasks.request: Support several overlapping or disjoint blocks without duplicating slots. Output ascending and preserve all prior behavior.

tasks.title: Invalid input
tasks.request: Reject malformed start/end/duration/step and malformed blocked intervals by returning [] without raising exceptions. Keep all prior cases.

tasks.title: Direct dependents
tasks.request: Implement affected(request): graph imports maps module to dependencies, changed lists modified modules. Return changed modules and direct dependents, sorted, ignoring unknown changed names.

tasks.title: Transitive impact
tasks.request: Follow reverse import edges transitively, not just direct dependents. Deterministic result for the same graph.

tasks.title: Cycles
tasks.request: Handle dependency cycles and self-imports without infinite loops or duplicated results.

tasks.title: Missing nodes
tasks.request: Ignore changed names that are not defined in graph keys; imports referring to missing modules do not create phantom result nodes.

tasks.title: Stable output
tasks.request: Guarantee lexicographically sorted result independent of changed input order, graph key order or repeated changed names.
acceptance: All earlier impact rules still pass

tasks.title: Put events
tasks.request: Implement reduce_events(events): replay valid put events into a dictionary of live key:value entries. Each event has id, key, op and integer rev.

tasks.title: Tombstones
tasks.request: Add delete operations which remove keys. A delete event with greater revision must prevent older puts from resurrecting data.

tasks.title: Idempotency
tasks.request: Ignore subsequent events with the same event id, even if their contents differ. Preserve earlier changes and avoid duplicate effects.

tasks.title: Monotonic revisions
tasks.request: Apply an event only if its integer revision is strictly larger than last revision for that key. Ignore invalid revision types.

tasks.title: Replay determinism
tasks.request: Return live keys in deterministic lexical order. Ignore malformed/unknown events and keep all previous stage semantics.

tasks.title: API key strings
tasks.request: Implement scrub(text) returning redacted text. Replace synthetic sk- keys with [REDACTED_TOKEN], preserve ordinary text.

tasks.title: Email strings
tasks.request: Redact email addresses as [REDACTED_EMAIL], including multiple emails; preserve previous API-key redaction.

tasks.title: Synthetic numeric IDs
tasks.request: Redact exactly eleven-digit stand-alone synthetic numeric identifiers using [REDACTED_ID]. Keep shorter/longer numeric strings intact.

tasks.title: Bearer headers
tasks.request: Redact Bearer credentials in text using [REDACTED_BEARER], case-insensitively. Do not leak authentication data.

tasks.title: Idempotent scrub
tasks.request: Ensure scrub(scrub(text)) == scrub(text) and nonsecret strings remain intact; preserve all earlier protections.
